about.label: Hero introduction
about.value: I’m John Clark Semblante, a WordPress/Full Stack Developer based in Mandaue City, Cebu. I started at Cebu Rent A Car in 2013, working on websites and on-page SEO. Since then, my work has included custom WordPress themes, ecommerce stores, and front-end interfaces for business and legal technology teams.

about.label: A lot of my work begins with a design file or a specific problem: a page looks wrong on a
about.value: A lot of my work begins with a design file or a specific problem: a page looks wrong on a phone, a plugin change breaks a layout, or a store needs a feature its theme doesn’t offer. I use PHP, JavaScript, and CSS to work through those requirements. That includes building custom WordPress themes, adjusting WooCommerce storefronts, and checking how changes behave across browsers and screen sizes.

about.label: My own ventures have given me another reason to keep websites straightforward. On Lazy Bar
about.value: My own ventures have given me another reason to keep websites straightforward. On Lazy Barista, visitors need to find the menu and ordering details. On Golden Travel and Tours, they need to explain their trip and request a quote. Those are the kinds of practical questions I think about when building a page.
